pages.text: This large shorebird can be found in larger beach biomes, where they spend their time alternating between wandering on land and swimming after fish to catch and eat them. Like penguins, they launch themselves across the shoreline in a leap, belly-first into the water and up and out of it onto land. They will all vanilla fish types and can be bred with them. They will pick up andesite dropped in front of them and use it to sharpen their beaks, polishing the andesite and creating an iron nugget in the process. When attacked on land the whole colony bolts for the water together, leaping in.
